items.title: Howard Johnson interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 14, 2019
items.q: And it’s that one-half hour a week with a guy named Wesley.

ctx.x: So you have to know the chord structure and how to get — I’m on this chord and I got to get to the next chord with some kind of movement. Was that something you learned before you played the instrument or did you learn it as you went along?

Ooh. Good question. Yeah. It’s hard to say one or the other. The thing is I was always into the bass line, even the Louis Jordan records, the piano players were still playing eight to the bar [scats]. Like that. And I could tell that these root notes meant something to not only the piano players and the bass players, but all the guys who were playing. No one had ever said the word “chord changes” to me, but they were there and there’s no missing them if you were listening. And I always liked arranging. I always…
